## What the grill changed

**The gate has three outcomes, not two** (D10). Draft / **ask** / refuse, decided by code — the model is never consulted on refusal, and is only used to word a gap question after code has decided to ask. This is the largest change: it moves interview machinery from Phase 4 into Phase 2 and turns the cold-start problem into the growth mechanism.

**Model vendor decided: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna** (D5b), after evaluating Claude Sonnet 5, Mistral Large 3, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K3, and Claude Fable 5. Cost per 20-question application drops from the estimated $0.20–0.30 to **≈$0.012**, which effectively unblocks D8.

**Capture became central and got a safety guard** (D12, D13, D16). Field values are read back at submit; every stored answer records how it was produced, so the style profile never learns Jobibi's own prose back from itself; and the question→field mapping is re-derived at capture to stop a broken adapter from silently corrupting memory.

**Copy cards carry a skeleton as well as a draft** (D14), and the anti-detection claim in PRODUCT.md softened to authenticity of substance — grounding defeats cross-applicant correlation, which is largely not what detection tooling reads.

**Gate calibration has a plan** (D15): relative scoring against each user's own distribution, an absolute floor underneath, tuned against a hand-built 50-case fixture that also serves as the unit test — which unblocks the core-loop slice without needing users.

- 2026-08-12 — **S5c completed** on branch `fm/jobibi-s5c-sensitive-fields`. Union sensitive-field detector in `packages/shared/src/gate/sensitive.ts` (D17): rule-based keyword match (`RULE_KEYWORDS`, deliberately narrow per kind) **or** retrieval match against the user's typed `sensitive_facts` (keyword-overlap stand-in for cosine similarity, `RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.25`, with a `cosineScores` override path for the production embedding score) — either signal firing routes to always-confirm (`detectSensitiveUnion` + `buildProvenanceLine`), unit-tested (`sensitive.test.ts`, 7 cases) against a dedicated oblique-phrasing golden set (`sensitiveGoldenSet.ts`) proving retrieval catches long-tail phrasing the narrow rule list misses. `supabase/functions/suggest/index.ts` runs the check immediately after normalizing the question and *before* retrieval, the gate, or any Luna call; on a hit it returns a new `confirm` outcome (`sensitiveKind`, `sensitiveFact` with provenance, `sensitiveVia`) instead of drafting. New Edge Function `supabase/functions/sensitive-confirm` (wired into `supabase/config.toml`) handles `confirm` (bump `confirmed_at` on the existing row via UPDATE, falling back to INSERT if RLS has no UPDATE policy) and `update` (INSERT a fresh row with a new `stated_at` and `confirmed_at` cleared) — both scoped to the caller's own JWT. `SuggestCard.tsx` renders the violet always-confirm card with the provenance line and Confirm/Update actions, or an intake prompt when the user has no fact of that kind yet. Four fixes landed at ship time: `ab8eecf` removed a `?debugSensitive` URL-gated verification harness from the production bundle (its screenshots had already been captured) before it could ship to real users; `bc251a8` (no-mistakes review) scoped `sensitive-confirm`'s `factId` lookup by `kind` as well as `id`/`user_id`, closing a path where a caller-supplied `factId` for one kind could be confirmed under a different kind; `22e4328` made the `sensitive_facts` check in `suggest/index.ts` fail-closed per D17 (a DB/check error now returns `confirm` with no fact instead of falling through to gate/draft) and dropped the `kind: X via: Y` internal-detector-state line from the shipped card (via attribution stays in logs/telemetry only); `57e9ab1` (no-mistakes review) fixed the fail-closed path to check the Supabase query's `error` field instead of only `data` and added a distinct "couldn't verify, try Suggest again" state to the confirm card for when `sensitiveKind` is missing. Verified: `packages/shared` 63 tests passed (7 new), `tsc --noEmit` 0.

- 2026-08-13 — **S7A completed** on branch `fm/jobibi-sensitive-storage-gate-s7a`. Prerequisite fix from a captain grilling session: `detectSensitiveUnion` (D17) previously only ran in `suggest` before drafting, leaving `gap-answer` and `capture` free to insert sensitive free text straight into `qa_pairs`/`memory_chunks`, bypassing `sensitive_facts`'s confirm/update lifecycle. `gap-answer/index.ts` and `capture/index.ts` now run the same union check (question + answer + combined) immediately before their inserts; a hit returns `409 sensitive_rejected` with provenance (`gap-answer`) or drops that answer from the batch and reports it via `droppedSensitive`/`sensitiveRejections` (`capture`) — reject-and-redirect to the existing sensitive-confirm card, never a silent background reclassification into `sensitive_facts`. New Edge Function `supabase/functions/manual-input` (wired into `supabase/config.toml`) adds the third insert path: a "provide input" textbox on the refuse-outcome card in `SuggestCard.tsx` (refuse has no anchor chunk, so this is cold raw-text capture, not anchored) that inserts into `qa_pairs` + `memory_chunks` immediately, tagged `user_written`, gated by the same check. `SuggestCard.tsx` also fixed a double-read of the sensitive-rejection error response body (`readSuggestErrorBody`/`messageFromSuggestErrorBody` split, since a `Response` body can only be consumed once) and routes any `sensitive_rejected` hit from gap-answer or manual-input to the confirm card. `JobStreetQuestions.tsx` surfaces `droppedSensitive` in the capture banner. Verified: `tsc --noEmit` 0.
- 2026-08-13 — **Live-testing bugfix** on branch `fm/jobibi-memory-chunks-qa-pair-type-fix`. S6's `20260812000000` migration intended to extend `memory_chunks.type`'s check constraint to allow `qa_pair` but didn't take effect against the live constraint; both `capture` (S6) and `manual-input` (S7A) insert `type='qa_pair'` rows, so every such insert violated the constraint. Both call sites swallowed the error with `console.warn` and returned success, so the UI showed "Saved to your memory bank" while the answer never reached `memory_chunks` and was invisible to retrieval/drafting. `supabase/migrations/20260813000001_memory_chunks_qa_pair_type.sql` drops whichever check constraint currently guards the `type` column — found via `pg_constraint`/`pg_attribute` matched on the constrained column rather than the rendered constraint text, since Postgres canonicalizes `IN (...)` to `= ANY (ARRAY[...])` — and recreates it including `qa_pair`, idempotently. `capture/index.ts` now tracks `memoryChunksFailed`, logs as `console.error`, and surfaces the count in its response (the batch still succeeds for the surrounding `qa_pairs`/`capture_mismatches` writes). `manual-input/index.ts` now returns `500` on a `memory_chunks` insert failure instead of a false success, so the refuse card shows an error rather than a misleading "saved" state.

- 2026-08-14 — **S9 completed** on branch `fm/jobibi-style-profile-s9`. `supabase/migrations/20260814000001_style_profile.sql` adds `style_profile` (one row per user, `profile_md`, `generated_at`, `corpus_size`, `rebuilding` + `rebuilding_started_at` + `batch_job_id` for the in-flight signal, RLS-scoped to the owning user). `packages/shared/src/styleProfile/styleProfile.ts` defines the voice-corpus helpers (D13-filtered union, 100-item cap, `shouldTriggerRebuild` delta check, `isInFlight` with 30-minute staleness guard, distillation prompt + length caps) and is unit-tested (`styleProfile.test.ts`, 8 cases). Qualifying write paths `capture`, `gap-answer`, `manual-input`, and `ingest` (only for `user_written`/`user_edited` documents, not `accepted_verbatim` or NULL-origin uploads) now call a shared helper (`supabase/functions/_shared/styleProfileTrigger.ts`) that checks `current - corpus_size >= 10` and fires a fire-and-forget `POST /functions/v1/style-profile` kick without touching `rebuilding` itself — `style-profile` alone owns the atomic in-flight claim (`update ... where rebuilding = false`, or `insert` on the `user_id` primary key), fixing an earlier bug where callers pre-claiming `rebuilding` made the auto-trigger path always see itself as in-flight and skip (D19). `docs/DECISIONS.md` gains D19, `docs/build/v0.1.md` expands the S9 stub, and this progress file records the ship.
